info.title: Amplitude Developer API
info.summary: OpenAPI-first contract for Amplitude CLI, MCP, SDK, and docs.
info.description:
Public developer-facing API contract for Amplitude resources.
This spec is intended to be the canonical source for generated CLI, MCP tools,
SDKs, and documentation.

tags.name: Taxonomy Event Properties
tags.description: Event-property taxonomy operations (scoped to an event).

tags.name: Taxonomy User Properties
tags.description: User-property taxonomy operations (scoped to a project).

tags.name: Feature Flags
tags.description: Feature flag configuration and rollout operations.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: OAuth device-flow and token endpoints (RFC 8628 / RFC 6749).

post.description: RFC 8628 device authorization endpoint. Initiates the device flow and returns a device_code, user_code, and verification URIs for the user to approve out of band, then poll the token endpoint.
RFC 6749 §3.2 token endpoint. Supports the `device_code` grant (RFC 8628). Authenticated by the fixed confidential device-flow client (injected server-side). Does not require a Bearer token.

400.description: Invalid or unsupported grant (RFC 6749 §5.2 OAuth error).

get.description: Returns the authenticated principal and organization context.
Returns projects visible to the authenticated principal.

get.summary: List event properties for an event
get.description:
Returns properties bound to a specific event, including ingested-only
properties (those with `is_in_schema: false`). Use the `is_in_schema`
flag to detect whether a `PATCH` will succeed before issuing it.

post.description:
Creates an event property and adds it to the project's tracking plan
(`is_in_schema: true` after success). If the property already exists in
the schema, the existing resource is returned without modification.
If the property exists ingested-only (`is_in_schema: false`), this call
promotes it into the schema with the metadata supplied here.

patch.description:
Updates metadata on an event property. Returns `422 not_in_schema` if
the property is ingested-only (`is_in_schema: false`); promote it via
`POST` first. Field absent means leave unchanged; field with `null`
clears (where allowed). `enum_values` and `classifications` replace the
array entirely — there is no per-item add/remove.

422.description:
Property is not part of the project's tracking plan. Returned when
attempting to PATCH a property with `is_in_schema: false`.

get.summary: List user properties for a project

post.description:
Creates a user property and adds it to the project's tracking plan.
Same idempotency semantics as `createEventProperty`.

patch.description:
Updates metadata on a user property. Returns `422 not_in_schema` if the
property is ingested-only. Same patch semantics as `updateEventProperty`
(field absent = unchanged, `null` = clear, arrays replace).

Only `display_name`, `description`, `is_hidden`, and `classifications`
are mutable via PATCH today. Type/shape fields (`data_type`,
`is_array_type`, `enum_values`, `regex`) are settable only at creation.
`is_official` is read-only until TMS exposes a write path for it.

422.description:
Property is not part of the project's tracking plan. Returned when
attempting to PATCH a property with `is_in_schema: false`.

key.description: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only.

patch.description: Updates feature flag metadata and rollout settings. Variant, tester, deployment, and link mutations will be exposed through dedicated subresources in a later slice.

ProjectId.name: project_id
ProjectId.description: Amplitude project identifier, backed by the canonical app ID.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Cursor token from previous list response.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Number of items to return. Defaults to 50, max 200.

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields. Prefix with `-` for descending.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique idempotency key used to safely retry write operations.

EventId.name: event_id
EventId.description: Public event identifier. For the current TMS-backed API, this value is the event type.

EventPropertyId.name: event_property_id
EventPropertyId.description:
Public event property identifier. Equal to `property_name`. URL-encode
when the property name contains spaces or special characters.

UserPropertyId.name: user_property_id
UserPropertyId.description:
Public user property identifier. Equal to `property_name`. URL-encode
when the property name contains spaces or special characters.

ExperimentId.name: experiment_id
ExperimentId.description: Experiment identifier. Experiments are backed by flag configurations and use the same identifier namespace.

Problem.description: Error response encoded as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

ValidationProblem.description: Validation failure response encoded as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

object.description:
Stable resource-type discriminator. Each resource sets a fixed value
(declared via `const` on the concrete schema, e.g. `project`, `event`).
Clients can use this field to safely narrow polymorphic responses.

event_type.description: Event this property is bound to.

is_hidden.description: Hidden from default UI surfaces and API listings.

is_in_schema.description:
Whether this property is part of the project's curated tracking
plan. `false` means ingested-only (seen via SDK calls but never
formally added). Properties with `is_in_schema: false` cannot be
modified — `PATCH` returns `422 not_in_schema` and metadata writes
are rejected. `POST` implicitly transitions a property to
`is_in_schema: true`.

classifications.description:
Data Access Controls (DAC) tags. Examples include `PII`,
`SENSITIVE`, `INTERNAL`.

is_in_schema.description:
Whether this property is part of the project's curated tracking
plan. Same semantics as `EventProperty.is_in_schema`.

PropertyDataType.description:
Logical data type of a property. `null` means untyped at the source;
clients should treat it as `string` for ingestion.

key.description: Stable variant key. The value `off` is reserved.

payload.description: Optional JSON payload returned by evaluation.

conditions.description: Omitted (or empty) for the catch-all "all other users" segment.

code_challenge.description: PKCE code challenge (RFC 7636): the base64url-encoded SHA-256 of your code_verifier.

code_challenge_method.description: PKCE challenge method. Must be S256.

grant_type.description: The OAuth grant type. Must be `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code`.

device_code.description: The device_code from the device-authorization response.

code_verifier.description: PKCE code verifier matching the code_challenge sent to the device-authorization endpoint.

RolloutWeights.description: Variant-keyed rollout weights. Values may be normalized to sum to 100 (percentages) or expressed as unnormalized relative weights (for example `{ "control": 1, "treatment": 1 }` for an even split). Weights are non-negative and may be fractional.

prop.description: Property name or cohort identifier being targeted.

prop_type.description: Namespace of the targeted property, for example `user`, `event`, or `group`. Omitted for conditions that target a cohort rather than a property.

op.description: Targeting operator applied to the property values.

values.description: At least one value to match against. Conditions with no values are rejected.
User IDs, device IDs, or cohort identifiers included in this variant. At most 2000 entries per variant (the limit is 10 when the entries are cohort identifiers).

deployments.description: Deployment IDs associated with this flag. Managed via the create/update deployment fields, not set directly on this field.

bucketing_key.description: Bucketing key used for assignment. Never null in responses; defaults to `amplitude_id` when not explicitly set.

version.description: Server-managed config version used for optimistic concurrency.

archived.description: Whether the resource is archived. Set via the archive (DELETE) operation.
